thread:
alex-cs: FYI — Acme opened a ticket. After today's canary, optional fields like delivery_date are showing up as empty strings \"\" instead of null/omitted. Their downstream validator fails. Ticket: https://acme.support/INC-1234

maria-eng: Can you paste a minimal request + the exact response they received? Also which model variant and which rollout did they hit?

alex-cs: Model: redwood/gpt-medium-v2 (canary). Rollout id: canary-2026-03-15-12:02. Repro I ran below.

alex-cs: Request (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"prompt":"Generate order JSON","format":"json","order_id":"A123"}'
```

alex-cs: Response (canary node):
```json
{"order_id":"A123","delivery_date":"","items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}]}
```

alex-cs: Non-canary (stable) for same request returned:
```json
{"order_id":"A123","delivery_date":null,"items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}]}
```

jordan-ml: Interesting — the generator in the canary appears to emit an explicit empty-string token for that field. Could be a prompt/template change or a postprocess sanitizer that coerces null->empty string. Any sanitization layers between generator and JSON assembly?

tyler-infra: We rolled a runtime micro-optimization (fast string-join kernel) to canary nodes at 2026-03-15T12:05Z which touched the JSON assembly hot path. Might be related.

maria-eng: Alex, can you also capture raw tokens or the debug trace? Run with trace/debug headers: `X-Redwood-Debug: tokens,trace` and paste output so ML/infra can inspect token stream.

alex-cs: Ran both traces. Raw token diff (excerpt):
```
stable tokens: [..., '\"delivery_date\": ', 'null', ...]
canary tokens: [..., '\"delivery_date\": ', '\"\"', ...]
```

jordan-ml: That matches. The model/postproc is returning an empty-string token sequence on canary. Could be that a small prompt template tweak or tokenizer change made the special NULL marker map to an empty-string literal in this path. I'll reproduce locally with the exact model weights + prompt.

maria-eng: Marking SEV2 — customer-facing impact, parser fails. @oncall please triage. If we confirm runtime change causes regression, we may need to rollback canary.

sam-bot: Linked ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7890 (labels: canary-regression, schema-break)

tyler-infra: Collecting logs from canary nodes and will attach dump here in ~30m. Also starting a canary-only run of the previous kernel to compare.

alex-cs: Customer asked for ETA — they are blocked on ingestion. They're pushing for rollback if fix > 2 hours.

maria-eng: Priority: get repro + root cause. Jordan, Tyler — coordinate. Alex, keep customer updated (we'll ask for temporary workaround: parser treat empty string as null). Thanks :pray:
